 Extensometer 
Extensometers MFA, MFE, MFX - Precise Strain Measurement for Demanding Applications
The MFA, MFE, and MFX extensometer series stand for high-precision strain measurement in materials testing. They are ideally suited for use with metal and plastic specimens and deliver reliable and repeatable results across a wide range of testing environments.
Extensometers MFA, MFE, MFX – Your solution for accurate, standards-compliant strain measurement in research, development, and quality assurance.
Extensometer MFA 25 / 12 – Precision Meets Versatility
The pivot-mounted extensometer MFA 25 / 12 offers a measuring range of 25 mm or 12 mm, covering a wide range of testing requirements. With its robust construction and precise mechanics, it is suitable for both standard applications and demanding testing conditions.
For tests under thermal influence, the device is also available in a climatic chamber version, suitable for temperatures ranging from +1 °C to +260 °C.
Technical Data at a Glance:
Feature
Value
Accuracy class
0.5 / 0.2 according to EN ISO 9513

Extensometer MFE – Specialist for High Elongations
The MFE extensometer is a long-travel arm strain measurement device, specifically designed for applications involving very high elongations – ideal for testing rubber, elastomers, and plastics. With an impressive measuring range of up to 900 mm, it offers maximum flexibility for a wide variety of material testing scenarios.
For temperature-critical applications, the MFE is also available in a version with climatic chamber measuring arms, allowing reliable use at temperatures of up to 350 °C.
Technical Data at a Glance:
Feature
Value

Measuring range
up to 900 mm

10 – 100 mm (other lengths available on request)
Temperature range
up to 350 °C (with climatic chamber measuring arms)
Extensometer MFX – Universally Applicable with Highest Precision
The MFX extensometer is a versatile strain measurement device, ideally suited for nearly all specimen types thanks to its robust construction and high measurement accuracy. It enables precise detection of strain – from modulus of elasticity to specimen failure – providing maximum flexibility in materials testing.
For testing under thermal conditions, the MFX is also available with climatic chamber measuring arms, rated for use at temperatures of up to 350 °C.
